title: Harness Hub 27cc200 sync and source-post migration
summary: Refreshed the local Harness Hub aggregation to source commit 27cc200d1108e8f382d5c49c64312c6b4561da85, migrated the renamed source-post skill into Codex and Claude curated skill surfaces, removed the stale source-to-insight-blog import, and preserved local workflow-router routing as an explicit overlay with the upstream copy stored under _harness-hub.

validation_commands: red source-alignment check failed before update with manifest commit 8ac264bed8a06fc6bf954a88ad92330e13e63e03 versus origin/main 27cc200d1108e8f382d5c49c64312c6b4561da85
node --test --test-name-pattern "Harness Hub skill aggregation|Claude Code curated skills expose|Harness Hub updater" tests/skills.test.js

lessons.lesson: Harness Hub updater state must distinguish stale imported skills from real local-only skills.
lessons.evidence: The source-to-insight-blog rename initially left the old skill in localOnlySkills even after its files were removed; the updater test now covers stale imported and stale local-only entries.
lessons.recommended_action: When a Hub skill disappears or is renamed, verify the aggregation manifest does not promote the old imported skill to local-only state.

lessons.lesson: Target repositories may need a workflow-router overlay for local maintenance language even when the upstream router is stricter.
lessons.evidence: The strict skills test caught the Harness Hub update prompt routing to review; workflow-router is now an overlapping skill with only route-intent.mjs preserved as a local conflict.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep target-specific router adaptations as overlapping skill conflicts instead of patching the upstream source checkout or silently editing imported skills.

lessons.lesson: Claude Code curation needs to follow skill renames, not just copied file updates.
lessons.evidence: The curated Claude surface now replaces source-to-insight-blog with source-post, updates insight and package-release-sniffer references, and has a regression test for the new name.
lessons.recommended_action: For every Harness Hub skill rename, update Codex aggregation, Claude curated README, copied skill bodies, and route tests in the same pass.

followups.action: Consider adding a first-class Claude curation command to the Harness Hub updater so source-post style renames cannot leave stale curated skill directories behind.
